title: Enterprise Connectivity: posted receivable magnitude
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this posted receivable magnitude rule to assisted customer credit payout.

## Basis: receivable
For assisted customer credit payout, sum all posted financial amount values on this holding; evidence and review records carry no receivable change.

## Basis: customer credit
For assisted customer credit payout, take the positive magnitude of a negative receivable, otherwise zero.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs assisted customer credit payout here?** Take the positive magnitude of a negative receivable, otherwise zero.

## Hypothetical signed account
A hypothetical signed receivable of negative USD 37 represents USD 37 of customer credit. A hypothetical positive receivable of USD 12 contributes zero customer credit.
